candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order POST /v1/orders returns HTTP 500, so the order service is the failing dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side cause (db pool, redis, payment) not established; only the 500 propagation is observed.

report.explanation: Traces and logs show every checkout 502 is preceded by an order POST /v1/orders 500 within the same correlation IDs; gateway itself is healthy (/readyz 200). Root cause is bounded to the order service returning 500, but the specific order-side failure mode is not yet evidenced.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for the 500 responses on POST /v1/orders
Order dependency metrics (postgresql pool, payment, inventory/redis) to distinguish db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, or downstream-latency
